script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.progress_percent, j.progress_message, j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at, j.lease_owner, DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.row_version, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.error_details, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.is_deleted,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.previousStatus')), NULL) AS prev_status
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_VCguard.data.jobId}}

SELECT st.step_name, st.step_status FROM gd_publish_step st WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_VCguard.data.jobId}}' AND st.step_name LIKE 'R%' AND st.is_deleted = 0
SELECT j.prepared_payload FROM gd_async_job j WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_VCguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT g.gr_status, CAST(g.gr_v2_job_id AS CHAR) AS gr_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('GRC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN goods_receiving g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_VCguard.data.jobId}} AND j.correlation_id REGEXP '^GR\\|[0-9]{1,20}$'

script.code:
SELECT p.job_id, p.step_name, p.result_ref, hj.job_status AS holder_status
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN JSON_TABLE(IF(JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload), j.prepared_payload, '{}'), '$.po_ids[*]' COLUMNS (po VARCHAR(20) PATH '$')) t
  JOIN gd_publish_step p
    ON p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = (CONCAT('GRPO|', t.po) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) AND p.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job hj
    ON hj.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p.step_name LIKE 'HOLD|%' AND p.result_ref REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$' AND hj.id = CAST(p.result_ref AS UNSIGNED)
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_VCguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST(m.item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(m.batch_number_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       CAST(MAX(m.id) AS CHAR) AS max_id,
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.transaction_type, ' ', COALESCE(m.trx_no, '')) ORDER BY m.id DESC SEPARATOR '|'), '|', 1) AS latest
  FROM inventory_movement m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND m.id > CAST('{{node:code_node_VCr0in.data.minLiveIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
   AND m.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_VCentry.data.organizationId}}'
   AND m.plant_id = CAST('{{node:code_node_VCr0in.data.plantIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
   AND m.item_id IN ({{node:code_node_VCr0in.data.itemIdsCsv}})
   AND NOT (m.transaction_type IN ('GRN', 'GRN-R') AND m.trx_no = '{{node:code_node_VCentry.data.grNoSql}}')
   AND NOT (m.transaction_type IN ('HU', 'HU-R') AND COALESCE(m.parent_trx_no, '') = '{{node:code_node_VCentry.data.grNoSql}}')
   AND NOT (m.transaction_type = 'TO - PA' AND COALESCE(m.parent_trx_no, '') = '{{node:code_node_VCentry.data.grNoSql}}')
   AND m.is_deleted = 0
 GROUP BY m.item_id, m.batch_number_id

script.code:
SELECT p.job_id, p.step_name, p.result_ref, hj.job_status AS holder_status
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN JSON_TABLE(IF(JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload), j.prepared_payload, '{}'), '$.po_ids[*]' COLUMNS (po VARCHAR(20) PATH '$')) t
  JOIN gd_publish_step p
    ON p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = (CONCAT('GRPO|', t.po) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) AND p.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job hj
    ON hj.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p.step_name LIKE 'HOLD|%' AND p.result_ref REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$' AND hj.id = CAST(p.result_ref AS UNSIGNED)
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_VCguard.data.jobId}}
